criteria.evidence: LinksController.create is a bare @Post() handler (src/links/links.controller.ts:10-13); Nest defaults POST to 201. Confirmed by re-running T3's verify command directly: exit 0.

criteria.criterion: The response body has exactly the fields slug, url, hits and createdAt.
criteria.evidence: LinksRepository.create returns `{ slug, url, hits: 0, createdAt }` (src/links/links.repository.ts:20), matching the LinkRecord interface with no extra fields; controller returns it directly.

criteria.criterion: slug matches ^[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$, url is the submitted url unchanged, and hits is the number 0 (not the string "0").
criteria.evidence: generateSlug() in links.service.ts:9-16 draws from a 62-char alphabet for exactly SLUG_LENGTH=6 chars; url is passed through unmodified; hits:0 is a numeric literal in the returned object (links.repository.ts:20), not read back from sqlite.

criteria.criterion: createdAt is an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds.
criteria.evidence: links.service.ts:24 uses `new Date().toISOString()`, which always yields the millisecond-precision UTC format the gate checks with `toISOString()` round-trip.

criteria.criterion: The link is written to the `links` table in the SQLite file named by DATABASE_PATH, and is still there after the process exits.
criteria.evidence: LinksRepository.create runs an INSERT against the injected DATABASE_CONNECTION (links.repository.ts:17-19), which database.module.ts opens against process.env.DATABASE_PATH. Gate re-run reads the rows back with a fresh DatabaseSync handle after stopping the server and finds them.

criteria.criterion: Submitting the same url twice creates two independent rows with different slugs — there is no de-duplication.
criteria.evidence: create() always calls generateSlug() and always inserts a new row; there is no lookup-by-url anywhere in the repository or service. Gate re-run posted the same url twice and got two distinct slugs and two rows.

criteria.criterion: The service never fetches or resolves the target url, and makes no outbound network call of any kind.
criteria.evidence: links.service.ts and links.repository.ts contain no fetch/http/dns/network calls — url is only stored and echoed back.

notes: Slug generation is a free function inline in the service rather than an injectable provider, and CreateLinkDto has no validation decorators — both correctly deferred to T7 and T6 per this task's own goal text ('Slug generation only has to produce a well-formed slug here...validation of bad input is T6's'). File set matches state.json's files list exactly, no scope creep. Re-ran T3's verify command directly (not just trusting the gate log, which only shows build warnings since the gate script prints nothing on success) — exit 0.
